correctness.rationale: Each isolation and gap requires six missing edges. Independently enumerated all local supports in C_40^3: minimal support unions for distinct isolation/isolation=11, gap/gap=9, mixed isolation/gap=9. All overlapping fixed event clusters cost at least three extra deleted edges, giving independent Poisson joint factorial moments. Independently checked boundaries of two-vertex components (10 edges) and consecutive three-vertex component (12). Published Federico component-envelope trichotomy and intertwined-chain witness bound yield O(q+nq^7+nq^10) exceptional disconnectivity, which vanishes when nq^6 approaches lambda. Infinite proof uses finite-range cluster enumeration and analytic rare-witness estimates, not finite checker output.
